newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy, corn open lower on good crop weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy, corn open lower on good crop weather.

text.p: U.S. grain and soy complex futures opening as of 0933 CDT.

WHEAT - 1/2 higher to one cent per bushel lower - Dragged down by soybeans and corn, but market still seen oversold. Rains slowing harvest in U.S. Southern Plains a bit, which is also supportive, traders said.
CORN - 1-1/2 to two cents lower - Favorable growing weather thoroughout the U.S. corn growing areas seen boosting the potential for the new crop.
SOYBEANS - Three to 4-3/4 cents lower - Rains and warm temperatures in the U.S. Midwest seen weighing on the market early, traders said.
SOY PRODUCTS - Soymeal $1.90 to $2.10 per ton lower, while soyoil flat to 0.04 cent per lb higher.
